plain_english_policy: This bill authorizes the officers and employees of the Alabama Higher Education Partnership, Inc. to join the Teachers' Retirement System (TRS). If adopted via resolution by the organization's governing body, these individuals become eligible for TRS benefits. The organization must pay employer contributions based on a percentage of salaries paid from its own funds, matching the timing of employee payments. Additionally, if included in their adoption resolution, current employees and officers can have prior service credited toward retirement eligibility, with the cost to fund this credit borne by the Alabama Higher Education Partnership.
policy_direction_if_enacted: Enactment would expand public pension coverage to include staff at a specific higher education entity (Alabama Higher Education Partnership, Inc.), integrating them into an existing state teachers' retirement framework. This creates a new class of participants in the TRS and establishes funding mechanisms for both ongoing contributions and potential retroactive service credit.
sponsorship_supports_position: Representative Lindsey (Education Appropriations) advanced this bill to expand retirement benefits coverage.
